criticalBehaviors.duplicateInitialization: Creating the same module on the same source element returns the existing instance.
criticalBehaviors.destroy: Destroy removes listeners, observers, timers, RAF handles, generated UI and restores owned DOM state.
criticalBehaviors.replay: Replay destroys and recreates the same module with prior or replacement options.
criticalBehaviors.reducedMotion: Reduced-motion mode does not start nonessential infinite animation loops.
criticalBehaviors.animatedMedia: GIF, APNG and animated WebP remain live media elements through Lazy, Ambient and Lightbox composition.
criticalBehaviors.lazyNoise: Print and Dissolve use changing fine-noise frames rather than a repeating static pattern.
criticalBehaviors.loaderSources: Loader accepts manual, promise, fetch, resource and window progress sources.
criticalBehaviors.lightboxViewer: Lightbox covers the full viewport and supports grouped navigation, information, zoom, pan, minimap and custom UI.
criticalBehaviors.smoothScroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is opt-in and can be enabled or disabled at runtime.
criticalBehaviors.boundedCardGlow: Pointer glow remains clipped while optional surface reflection and luminous border are independently configurable.

variantCapabilities.any: No requirement — works on any element.
variantCapabilities.image: Needs an (the element itself or a descendant).
variantCapabilities.text: Needs rendered text and no image to operate on.
variantCapabilities.items: Needs two or more element children to sequence.
variantCapabilities.track: Needs a .kt-slider-track descendant for track-based slider effects.
